description: Synthetic bilingual lexical retrieval fixture v2: shared-vocabulary disambiguation, token-order variation, near-synonym overlap and a negative query. Lexical only; it does not measure semantic translation or host billing.

records.title: SQLite WAL consistent backup
records.content: Use an online SQLite snapshot to include committed WAL records; verify integrity before restore.

records.title: SQLite 在线备份与完整性
records.content: 运行中的数据库使用在线快照，不直接复制主文件；恢复前核对完整性和来源。

records.title: Compare and swap revision guard
records.content: Explicit revision updates require the expected snapshot digest before overwrite.

records.title: 比较并交换的版本守卫
records.content: 显式修订必须带上期望快照摘要，避免静默覆盖已改变状态。

records.title: Rollback keeps security policy
records.content: Restoring configuration must retain the hardened admission policy.

records.title: Linked worktree identity
records.content: An unbound worktree must not create a second project identity.

records.title: Backup retention policy
records.content: Retention keeps old database copies for thirty days.
